content_feed.telegram_post: 🚀 #NEW_PRODUCT | Veegaland Developers Limited (NSE: VEEGALAND) Veegaland Developers launches residential project 'Veegaland Fortune' in Kochi ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Project Name: Veegaland Fortune - Location: Kathrikkadavu, Kaloor, Ernakulam, Kerala - Category: Residential Apartments - Saleable Area Added: 1,78,905 sq. ft. - RERA Registration: K-RERA/PRJ/ERN/168/2026 - Validity: June 30, 2031 📌 What happened: ↳ The company has officially launched its residential apartment project following the receipt of registration from the Kerala Real Estate Regulatory Authority (K-RERA). ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: M & B Engineering commences commercial production at Sanand facility
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Commencement of commercial production at a new brownfield facility expansion representing a material operational capacity addition.
